name: io.github.cronus42/ibc-mcp
description: Research-grade interior-ballistics solver as a remote MCP server: modeled velocity/energy/pressure for exact cartridge+bullet+powder+charge specifications, charge work-up ladders, 3-DOF trajectory tables, and component lookups from a served database. Every result carries a non-removable safety envelope: this is modeling output, not published load data; start low and work up. The engine publishes its own error rates: graded against 30,327 printed loads at launch, average velocity error about 7.5%, worst powders included in the public table.
